messages.2コインのS2「双撃」でマッチを支え、強力な敵スキルには1コインの切り札S3「過: A Slash Identity that relies on the 2-Coin S2 Dual Strike for clashes and saves the single-Coin S3 Overbreathe to stop strong enemy skills. S3 gains a bonus at 10 or more Speed.
messages.S3「過呼吸」: 1コインで、マッチ威力4〜25(基本威力4、コイン威力+21): **S3 — Overbreathe**: 1 Coin with Clash Power 4–25 (4 Base Power, +21 Coin Power). +3/5 Skill Power at 10 or more Speed. If it lands Heads, it can beat even strong enemy skills.
messages.S2「双撃」: 2コイン(マッチ威力3〜15/4〜16)で、主力のマッチスキル。: **S2 — Dual Strike**: 2 Coins (Clash Power 3–15/4–16) and her main Clash skill. On hit, Coin Ⅱ grants 2/3 Haste next turn. Below 50% HP, it also grants 2/4 Haste next turn on use.
messages.体力減少で速度10に届く: 同期化Ⅳで体力50%未満なら、S2の使用時(4)とⅡ: **Reaching 10 Speed through lost HP**: At Uptie Ⅳ and below 50% HP, S2 grants 7 Haste next turn: 4 on use and 3 on Coin Ⅱ hit. Her minimum Speed is 3, so this brings her to 10 or more.
messages.S1「息を整える」: 1コイン。使用時に次のターンのクイック2を得る。Ⅰコインで: **S1 — Catch Breath**: 1 Coin. Grants 2 Haste next turn on use. Coin Ⅰ grants 2 Poise next turn.
messages.バトルパッシブ「心構え」(憤怒×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 次のターンにクイッ: **Combat passive — Prepared Mind (3 Wrath Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains Haste next turn equal to (Wrath Resonance ÷ 3).
messages.サポートパッシブ「両断」(憤怒×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最も高い味方: **Support passive — Divide in Two (5 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: The 1 fastest ally deals +10% damage with Slash skills.
messages.S1は一方攻撃に回してクイックを取り、マッチはS2に任せる。速度10以上のターン: Use S1 for one-sided attacks to collect Haste, and leave Clashes to S2. On turns with 10 or more Speed, hold S3 and throw it at the enemy's strong skill to stop it. With few Coins, her total damage is limited, so use her to stop enemy attacks through Clashes. Both her HP and Defense Level are lowish, so avoid forced Clashes early on when SP is low.
